queries:
WITH p AS (
    SELECT ID,
           AVG(HGB * 1.0 / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS ratio,
           AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING AVG(HGB * 1.0 / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) IS NOT NULL
),
a AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS overall_avg FROM p
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic,
       AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
       AVG(p.ratio - a.overall_avg) AS mean_excess
FROM p, a
WHERE p.ratio > a.overall_avg;
WITH p AS (
    SELECT ID,
           AVG(HGB) * 1.0 / AVG(HCT) AS ratio,
           AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
    HAVING AVG(HGB) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) IS NOT NULL AND AVG(HCT) <> 0
),
m AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM p
)
SELECT AVG(p.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic,
       AVG(p.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
       AVG(p.ratio - m.mean_ratio) AS mean_excess
FROM p, m
WHERE p.ratio > m.mean_ratio;
WITH g AS (
    SELECT AVG(HGB * 1.0 / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS a
    FROM Laboratory
),
p AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(HGB * 1.0 / NULLIF(HCT, 0)) AS r, AVG(PIC) AS pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT AVG(p.pic), AVG(p.r), AVG(p.r - g.a)
FROM p, g
WHERE p.r > g.a;
WITH latest AS (
    SELECT l.ID, l.HGB * 1.0 / l.HCT AS ratio
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT IS NOT NULL AND l.HCT <> 0
      AND l.Date = (
          SELECT MAX(l2.Date)
          FROM Laboratory l2
          WHERE l2.ID = l.ID AND l2.HGB IS NOT NULL AND l2.HCT IS NOT NULL AND l2.HCT <> 0
      )
),
avgpic AS (
    SELECT ID, AVG(PIC) AS avg_pic
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
),
stats AS (
    SELECT AVG(ratio) AS mean_ratio FROM latest
)
SELECT AVG(a.avg_pic) AS mean_avg_pic,
       AVG(l.ratio) AS mean_ratio,
       AVG(l.ratio - s.mean_ratio) AS mean_excess
FROM latest l
JOIN avgpic a ON a.ID = l.ID
CROSS JOIN stats s
WHERE l.ratio > s.mean_ratio;
